scientific.integrity: The arbitrary-field theorem is proved symbolically from the three idempotent equations. Finite-field enumeration over several prime fields and over F_9 is a consistency check only, not evidence for the general proof.
scientific.limitations: The classification is for K-rational idempotents of the three-element dihedral quandle algebra over a field; it does not cover larger quandles, nonfield coefficient rings, or scheme-theoretic multiplicities.

title: A characteristic-three idempotent line in the quandle algebra of \(R_3\)
